# ESLint, Prettier, and Tailwind Setup

#### Course: Rapid Build With Claude Code

## ESLint, Prettier, and Tailwind Setup

Three more tools were configured before the first Claude Code prompt: ESLint, Prettier, and Tailwind CSS.

ESLint catches code quality issues - unused variables, missing dependencies in React hooks, unsafe type assertions. Running ESLint after each chunk is part of the verification checklist.

Prettier enforces consistent formatting. When Claude Code generates code, it may use 2-space or 4-space indentation depending on context. Prettier normalizes everything automatically on save.

Tailwind CSS was installed and configured with the custom token set from Chapter 3:

```react
yarn add -D tailwindcss postcss autoprefixer npx tailwindcss init -p
```

The tailwind.config.ts then received the full design token extension from the brand guidelines. This was the last manual setup step before Chunk 1 ran.
